# Microsoft Learn

> > Microsoft Learn is a comprehensive learning platform offering technical documentation, hands-on training, AI and cloud certifications, and community support to help developers build practical skills across Azure, .NET, Microsoft 365, and emerging technologies.

Microsoft Learn serves as the central hub for technical education and professional development across Microsoft's product ecosystem. The platform combines self-paced training modules, certification preparation, official documentation, and community-driven Q&A to support learners from beginners to advanced professionals.

## Key Topics

- Azure cloud services
- AI fundamentals and generative AI
- Microsoft Copilot
- Certifications and credentials
- Training courses and modules
- Technical documentation
- .NET development
- Skill development
- Career advancement
- Cloud concepts
- AI agents
- Responsible AI
- Microsoft 365
- Learning paths
- Community support

## Core Learning Hubs

- [Microsoft Learn: Build skills that open doors in your career](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft Learn homepage offering technical skills, certifications, and community
- [Azure documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure): Azure cloud services documentation, tutorials, and developer resources
- [Technical documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/docs): Technical documentation hub for .NET, Azure, C++, and Microsoft tools
- [AI learning hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/ai): AI learning hub for foundational AI training and Copilot skills development
- [Learn how to use Microsoft Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot): Microsoft Copilot learning hub for training and extensibility resources

## Certifications & Credentials

- [Professional and Technical Credentials and Certifications](https://learn.microsoft.com/credentials): Microsoft credentials, certifications, and applied skills hub
- [Course AI-900T00-A: Introduction to AI in Azure - Training](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/courses/ai-900t00): AI-900 certification prep course introducing AI fundamentals in Azure
- [Student Certifications - Student Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/student-hub/certifications): Student certifications guide with discounts and beginner-friendly exams

## Training Modules & Learning Paths

- [Introduction to generative AI and agents - Training](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/modules/fundamentals-generative-ai): Training module on generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents fundamentals
- [Introduction to Cloud Infrastructure: Describe Cloud Concepts - Training](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/paths/microsoft-azure-fundamentals-describe-cloud-concepts): Azure fundamentals learning path covering cloud concepts for AZ-900

## Community & Support

- [Microsoft Q&A](https://learn.microsoft.com/answers): Microsoft Q&A platform for technical questions and community support
- [Experts Hub: Share what you know. Shape what's next. - Contributor guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/contribute): Contributor guide for sharing expertise on Microsoft Q&A and Experts Hub

## Product Lifecycle & Browser Support

- [Lifecycle FAQ - Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/faq/internet-explorer-microsoft-edge): FAQ on lifecycle policy for Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge browsers

## Optional Resources

- [Principles for AI-Generated Content](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/principles-for-ai-generated-content): Microsoft's approach and principles for AI-generated content disclosure
- [Microsoft previous versions of technical documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions): Archive of deprecated product versions and legacy technical documentation
- [Terms of Use](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/termsofuse): Terms of Use and service agreement for learn.microsoft.com platform
